title: daily scratchpad - gpu ops 37
content:
Quick notes & todo (personal) - GPU ops

TODAY (2026-03-04)
- Morning: check cluster capacity dashboard (grafana/gpu-cluster-main). look for any nodes > 90% memory for > 10m -> if found, move low-priority pods to preemptible pool.
- Follow up on INFRA-482 (autoscaler policy drift) - Priya left notes; need to run sim with current seq-length distribution (sample from logs 02/26-03/03).
- Apply kernel patch to nvlink hosts in us-west-2 (staging first): test nodes 10-12. reimage window 23:00-01:00 PST. notify oncall rotation (Liam).
- Reminder: upgrade nvidia-driver to 545.68 on builders (not trainers) -- check compatibility matrix before pushing.

SHORT / QUICK TODOs
- [ ] Run nightly CVM capacity script (scripts/gpu/cvm-check.sh) -> capture output to /tmp/cvm-03-04.log
- [ ] Add low-memory eviction policy to kube config for preemptible nodes (check kube-ops PR template)
- [ ] Post brief to #infra-gpu about planned outage (include rollback steps)
- [ ] Verify KMS access for private deployment test in staging-3 (ticket: INFRA-499)

ISSUES / FLAGS
- Observed 2x OOMs on trainer-rt-07 yesterday at ~02:10 UTC. logs point to spike in batch size for model-rerank-v2. Need to:
  - roll back to model-rerank-v2@2026-02-28 if repeat during load test
  - add a guard in serving-router to reject requests > 4096 tokens for that model variant

NOTES TO SELF / COMMANDS
- Quick check commands:
  - kubectl get pods -n gpu --field-selector=status.phase=Pending
  - ssh gpu-admin@staging-11 'nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv'
  - python tools/seqdist/summarize.py --start 2026-02-26 --end 2026-03-03 > seq-dist-02-26_03-03.json

AFTER-HOURS PLAN
- If autoscaler test fails, trigger emergency rollback of autoscaler changes: revert PR #124 on infra-autoscaler repo, restart controller-manager, monitor replication status for 15m. Keep phone on.

QUESTIONS / FOLLOW UPS
- Ask research: can they reduce live batch sizes for rerank by 10% without accuracy hit? (ping: @maria-research)
- Do we want preemption window to be 60s or 120s for training jobs? lean toward 120s for safer checkpointing.

LINKED REFERENCES (quick)
- INFRA-482 (autoscaler) -> notes + simulation script link in Confluence
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/reprovisioning/pull/123 (reprovisioning improvements)
- Slack thread: #infra-gpu (thread ts: 1710000000.000200)

END

(handy: this file is a scratchpad — short lived, copy important bits to Confluence or tickets once stable)
